## Overiew 
For this project, I am analyzing a Publicly availble dataset related to the inpatients within the state of Florida. I chose this data set because it is clean, well documented, and appropriate for practing data loading and basuc transformating in R. 

## Planned approach 
My plan is to explore basic charateristics of the number of inpatients in the state of Florida, including variable types and summuary statistics. i plan to load the data into R and perform simple transformations to make the data easier to analyze 

## Anticipated Challanges 
Potential challanges include ensuring the data set is loaded from a public url and confirming that variables are correctly formatted for analysis

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:
